segments.say: Chess rule number two. White's king steps to f1, then walks straight back. Nothing has changed. Can White castle now?
segments.caption: The king went back. Castle?

segments.say: No! Once the king has moved, castling is gone for the rest of the game, even if it walks back.
Did you know this? Rule number 3 drops tomorrow. Subscribe so you don't miss it.
segments.caption: Rule #3 tomorrow!
